lines: I made it back because I ran exactly the clever amount. No one measures that.
I only ran the wrong way once, maybe twice, and then I found the right door.
I survived by making several choices very quickly and only some of them silly.
The door was exactly where I hoped it was. Eventually.
I came back alive, which is my favorite kind of back.
I was brave for at least three seconds. The rest was very fast walking.
Someone shouted run, and I became excellent at listening.
I made it home and only lost one thought on the way.
When danger came close, nobody had time to sound brave first.
You learn a lot about a village when everyone hears the bell at once.
